source_text: Organizations like the International Network of Involuntary Circumcision of Children frame it as a human rights infringement on bodily autonomy, akin to denying the child's agency over irreversible modifications, with empirical data showing complication rates of 0.2-2% in clinical settings but higher in traditional rites.
